## Checklist

- [ ] I edited a page in `docs/`, not `README.md`, `tools.json` or `tools.csv` (those are generated).
- [ ] The entry follows the one-line format and the access term is one of: Free account, Freemium, Free, Paid, Enterprise quote, Share-to-get, On application.
- [ ] The owner or operator is named.
- [ ] I opened the URL today and it works without an invitation.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/build_readme.py` and committed `README.md`, `tools.json` and `tools.csv`, or I ticked "Allow edits by maintainers" so we can regenerate them.
